body: DESIGN COURT READY FOR CHIEF DISPOSITION: docs/design/nfrd-baseball-diagnostic-court.md under bd-01M17MT2JC0TS46BH9RTYMEVQ7. The proposal keeps the first implementation inside the existing JVM-only embed-bench project, adds no module or dependency, and keeps all NFRD vocabulary private[bench]. A pure verifier follows the existing FrozenSet pattern; a narrow filesystem adapter reads an explicit external root and refuses traversal or symlink escape. Git pins only the two 113-entry aggregate manifest digests plus the three non-participant stimulus hashes; participant IDs, per-file hashes, and bytes stay external. The verifier requires exact pair equality, verifies every byte and size, carries a complete Observation/Derivation/Unknown ledger, and freezes a hash-ranked 57/28/28 participant split before transcript parsing. The output is an unforgeable non-disclosing input receipt and remains Origin.Diagnostic. No hand-authored Baseball graph and no claim of a scientific result. Requested decisions are the home, package-private case vocabulary, aggregate-only git posture, split protocol, and separation from the eventual general admitted-story loader. git diff --check is clean. I will not reserve code paths until this architecture line is dispositioned.
